   - 2020 census: 1,978,742
   - 2023 estimate: 1,931,212
   - 2025 census: 1,891,489
   [citypopulation.de](https://www.citypopulation.de/en/japan/admin/21__gifu), [Data Commons](https://datacommons.org/place/wikidataId/Q131277)

Interpolating for **August 1, 2024**, the population would be approximately **~1,910,000–1,920,000**.

Rounded to the nearest million: **2 million**

Answer in characters: **2**
